I love my job.|An Imperial captain and a TIE pilot|[[Star Wars (2015) 8|''Star Wars'' (2015) 8]]}} The '''TIE/sa tactical bomber''', also known as the '''TIE Surface Assault Bomber''', '''TIE/sa bomber''' or simply the '''TIE bomber''', was a [[Bomber|bombing]] variant of the [[TIE series]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]]. An evolution of the [[TIE/gt]], the TIE [[bomber]] was their main source of anti-emplacement air-support. They were nicknamed "'''[[List of phrases and slang#D|dupes]]'''" by the [[New Republic]] [[pilot]] [[Wyl Lark]] and known as '''First Order bombers''' during their service in the [[First Order Navy]]. ==Characteristics== {{Quote|Two distinctive, elongated spaceframe pods— one houses the pilot, the other the payload. In addition to whatever detonite it's dropping, the TIE bomber has homing missiles and a pair of laser cannons.|Antoc Merrick|''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''}} The TIE/sa [[bomber]] was specifically designed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] for use in the [[Imperial Military|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. A model of [[light bomber]], it was part of the [[TIE series]] of [[starfighter]]s, distinguished by their [[twin ion engine]]s and [[solar collector]] panels. The bomber measured 7.9 [[meter]]s long, 10.6 meters wide, and 5.4 meters high. In keeping with the Empire's preference for muted [[color]]s,''[[Star Wars Rebels: A New Hero]]'' it was painted a bluish gray. [[File:VillageBombed-BountyHunters31.jpg|thumb|left|250px|TIE bombers carry out a bombing run on Bestine IV.]] Like the [[TIE Advanced x1]] prototype, the TIE/sa bomber had inclined wings, which maximized its speed and maneuverability while carrying mass of heavy ordnance. Unlike the other models in the TIE line, the bomber had not one but two central pods: a starboard [[cockpit]] for the pilot and a portside ordnance bay for the munitions. The cockpit featured two forward-mounted [[laser cannon]]s, the standard [[transparisteel]] [[viewport]], and an [[ejector seat]] in case a [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|pilot]] on a distant bombing run needed to abandon [[Starship|ship]]. The ordnance bay was divided into two sections. The forward ordnance bay carried either eight [[concussion missile]]s or four [[proton torpedo]]es. The main ordnance bay carried either four proton torpedoes and eight concussion [[missile]]s, or eight [[proton bomb]]s and sixty-four [[thermal detonator]]s, or six [[space mine]]s, or even [[stormtrooper]]s. Located underneath the ordnance pod was a [[bomb]] chute connected to the ship's targeting systems, a [[T-s7b targeting computer|T-s7b]] [[targeting computer]] and a [[398X bomb sight]]. The pod also featured a missile port that allowed for front-launching and torpedoes. The ordnance bay could also be swapped for a passenger cabin with room for six. They were described by [[Paige Tico]] as [[Color|gray]] and bat-winged. For pilot survival, the bomber was equipped with a cockpit [[ejector seat]]. Pilots also had life support, but still wore [[TIE pilot flight suit|flight suits]] in case of emergency.''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' ==Role==
[[File:TIE_Bomber_BF2.png|thumb|left|270px|A TIE bomber]]
Evolving from the [[TIE/gt]],[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] TIE bombers were a main source of anti-emplacement, anti-trap air support for the Empire.''[[Star Wars: Commander]]'' They often served in the first line of attack, and [[Star Destroyer]] [[captain]]s liked to send them out to carpet bomb and weaken large targets like [[capital ship]]s in [[Realspace|space]] or buildings on the ground. ==History== ===Imperial frontlines=== {{Quote|That tub? Are you kiding?''"
"''Hey, it can take a hit. Now, can you fly it or not?''"
"''I can fly anything.|Wedge Antillies and Sabine Wren, while stealing a TIE Bomber|}} [[File:MajorRhymerLoadout-SWZ98.png|thumb|left|300px|A TIE bomber flies through space]] A [[Standard decade|decade]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the Empire, one was deployed by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Ultimatum]]'' in order to attack the mobile refinery ''[[Forager]]'' used by the corrupt [[Count]] [[Denetrius Vidian]].[[A New Dawn (novel)|''A New Dawn'']] Three [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]],''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' states that [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] was 16 [[Standard year|years]] old during her [[Mission on Lothal|mission]] on [[Lothal]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that Organa was [[Reproduction|born]] in [[19 BBY]], [[Phoenix Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Ryloth (Phoenix Squadron)|mission to Ryloth]] must take place in [[3 BBY]]. ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (3 BBY)|attack]] on [[Phoenix Squadron]] to three [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], or [[3 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' [[Galactic standard calendar|dating system]]. As this mission takes place between these two events, it must also take place in 3 BBY. TIE/sa bombers were being launched from a [[Phoenix Nest|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier]] above [[Ryloth]] to attack [[Cham Syndulla]]'s [[Free Ryloth Movement|rebel cell]]. Collaborating with the [[Spectres|Lothal rebel cell]], Syndulla's rebels managed to steal a single TIE Bomber, which they used as a boarding shuttle, stagging a [[Mission to Ryloth (Phoenix Squadron)|false attack]] with two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]s from [[Phoenix Squadron]] to land their TIE Bomber in one of the [[carrier]]'s hanger bays, from which the Specters and three members of Syndulla's cell including Cham himself stormed the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|vessel]], seizing control of the Quasar and later defending it from a counterattack by a squad of TIE Bombers, all of which were destroyed by the rebels before retreating from Ryloth with the captured Quasar. In [[2 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' an operative of Phoenix Squadron, [[Sabine Wren]] infiltrated the [[Skystrike Academy]] on [[Montross]] to aid two Imperial pilots in defecting to the growing rebellion, stealing a TIE/sa bomber from Skystrike to transport herself and defecting pilots [[Wedge Antilles]] and [[Derek Klivian]] to a [[CR90 corvette]] commanded by Phoenix Squadron, and retreat to rebel controlled [[Atollon]]. [[File:TIEsaBomberOverHothAsteroid-MF99.png|thumb|300px|right|A TIE/sa bomber flies over a large asteroid in the Hoth asteroid field.]] At least one was present aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] during the Battle of Yavin.''[[The Adventures of Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight]]'' During the [[Battle for Tatooine]], operatives of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] from a [[Tatooine rebel cell|local rebel cell]] managed to steal TIE/sa bombers from the Empire and used them in their fight to liberate [[Tatooine]] from the [[Tatooine garrison|local Imperial garrison]] and the [[68th Legion]], the later of which also used TIE/sa bombers to combat the rebel cell. After the [[Battle of Hoth]], several TIE/sa bombers were deployed by [[Death Squadron]] to flush the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' out from the [[Hoth asteroid field|asteroid field]] it was hidden in. [[File:Bombing-of-Mandalore.png|thumb|left|290px|TIE bombers scoured the surface of Mandalore, resulting in swathes of the Mandalorian population killed]] A contingent of TIE/sa bombers, consisting of a multitude of squadrons, assisted in carrying out the [[Great Purge of Mandalore|Great Purge]], during which, they [[Bomb|annihilated]] the surface of Mandalore{{BOBF|Chapter 5: Return of the Mandalorian}} and destroyed multiple cities{{InsiderCite|219|A Certain Point of View}} during the [[Night of a Thousand Tears]]. Six TIE bombers were deployed to [[Mission to Bestine IV|put down]] an [[insurrection on Bestine IV]] by bombing a [[Unidentified village (Bestine IV)|village]] where the insurgents made camp.[[Bounty Hunters 31|''Bounty Hunters'' 31]] ===Collapse of the Empire=== The bombers also participated in actions related to [[Operation: Cinder]], 17 [[Standard day|days]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], serving at the [[Battle of Cawa City]], on [[Sterdic IV]] in [[4 ABY]].[[Shattered Empire 2|''Shattered Empire'' 2]] Gideon's Imperial remnant used bombers during the [[Bombing of Kryze Castle]]. [[Gideon's Imperial remnant]] continued to use bombers up until his [[Conflict on Mandalore|defeat]].{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}} ===Legacy=== Over two decades after the establishment of the [[New Republic]] and the time of the [[Cold War]], the [[First Order]] made use of the TIE/sa as the First Order bomber. The First Order also came to use the [[TIE/se Bomber]],[[Allegiance 1|''Allegiance'' 1]] many of which would go on to participate in the First Order-Resistance conflict.{{Resistance|No Place Safe}}
